e.body:
Annals of Actuarial Science 是**英国精算师协会（IFoA）的会刊**，由 Cambridge University Press 出版（`cambridge.org/core/journals/annals-of-actuarial-science`）。可核实信息：**ISSN 1748-4995（印刷）/ 1748-5002（在线）**，**主编 Andreas Tsanakas**（City St George’s, University of London），编委含 Andrew Cairns、Angus Macdonald 等知名精算学者；学科归类为「社会科学—数学方法 / 数学—交叉应用 / 统计与概率」，期刊页面列有 2025 年影响因子与全部过刊（All issues）。

对 RIAA：这是**英式精算研究的主场之一**，与 [[ifoa]] 的资格与教育体系同源——若考虑在英国体系下做研究或深造，这是最需要对标的期刊。它和本 wiki 已有的 [[astin-bulletin]]（IAA 非寿险分会会刊，**产险方法论**为主）形成互补：ASTIN Bulletin 偏方法（准备金、极值、定价），Annals 覆盖面更宽（含职业议题、监管、数据科学）。文献检索入口见 [[repec-g22]]（JEL G22），研究资源见 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[ifoa-data-science-research]]，开放教材见 [[actuarial-open-book]]，近期预印本例子见 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]。适合作文献综述、投稿方向选择与研究型作业。**核实说明**：期刊主页与过刊页均 HTTP 200（745KB / 803KB）实测；**未核实具体文章全文**（多数需订阅或机构访问）。
e.body_en:
Annals of Actuarial Science is **the journal of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA)**, published by Cambridge University Press (`cambridge.org/core/journals/annals-of-actuarial-science`). Verifiable details: **ISSN 1748-4995 (print) / 1748-5002 (online)**, **Editor Andreas Tsanakas** (City St George’s, University of London), with an editorial board including well-known actuarial academics such as Andrew Cairns and Angus Macdonald; its subject classifications are "Social Sciences – Mathematical Methods / Mathematics – Interdisciplinary Applications / Statistics and Probability", and the journal page lists a 2025 impact factor plus the full archive (All issues).

For RIAA: this is **one of the main venues for British-style actuarial research**, sharing its lineage with the [[ifoa]] qualification and education system — the journal to benchmark against if you are considering research or further study within the UK system. It complements this wiki’s existing [[astin-bulletin]] (the IAA’s non-life section journal, focused on **general insurance methodology**): ASTIN Bulletin leans methodological (reserving, extremes, pricing) while Annals covers a wider remit including professional issues, regulation and data science. For literature searching see [[repec-g22]] (JEL G22); research resources in [[cas-research-tools]] and [[ifoa-data-science-research]]; open textbooks in [[actuarial-open-book]]; a recent preprint example in [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]. Suits literature reviews, choosing where to submit, and research assignments. **Verification note**: the journal home page and archive page were both measured at HTTP 200 (745KB / 803KB); **individual article full texts were not verified** (most require a subscription or institutional access).

Annals of Actuarial Science 是**英國精算師協會（IFoA）的會刊**，由 Cambridge University Press 出版。可核實資訊：**ISSN 1748-4995（印刷）/ 1748-5002（在線）**，**主編 Andreas Tsanakas**（City St George’s, University of London），編委含 Andrew Cairns、Angus Macdonald 等知名精算學者。

對 RIAA：這是**英式精算研究的主場之一**，與 [[ifoa]] 的資格與教育體系同源。它與已有的 [[astin-bulletin]]（IAA 非壽險分會會刊，**產險方法論**為主）形成互補：ASTIN Bulletin 偏方法，Annals 覆蓋面更寬（含職業議題、監管、數據科學）。文獻檢索入口見 [[repec-g22]]，研究資源見 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[ifoa-data-science-research]]，開放教材見 [[actuarial-open-book]]。適合作文獻綜述、投稿方向選擇與研究型作業。**核實說明**：期刊主頁與過刊頁均 HTTP 200 實測；**未核實具體文章全文**。
